translations: Him So how are you deluded
puzzle.hint: A powerful affirmation of pure monotheism (Tawhid) — affirming that Allah alone is the Creator and the only deity worthy of worship.
puzzle.arabic: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: That is Allāh, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
